title: A second engine: Nano Banana Pro

items.title: Google's Nano Banana Pro, in the Model list
items.body: Under a Google heading, beside xAI's models, once the server has a Google key with billing on it. Same box, same photos, same Library and Projects — pick it per run, or make it a project's default.

items.title: It thinks before it draws
items.body: Expect 10–30 seconds a picture; the tile says Thinking. Its price is a floor — the composer says “from $0.13” — because Google bills the thinking on top. The real cost shows with the picture.

items.title: 4K
items.body: Nano Banana Pro offers 4K (about 16 MP) alongside 1K and 2K, for print and crops. 2:1 is xAI-only; switching models falls back to a shape the model can do.

items.title: Money
items.body: Spent today counts both engines. The “left” figure is still xAI's prepaid credit — Google is pay-as-you-go on a card and has no balance to read.

title: Projects, and the older pictures are back

items.title: The money is right
items.body: “Spent today” is now what everyone on the team has spent since midnight, your time — it used to count only this browser. And the “left” figure now moves as you work: xAI reports the cycle's spend in a separate field, which was being missed.

items.title: Older pictures are back
items.body: The gallery had been stopping early: once enough recent runs were deleted, it took a short first page for the end of the history and never loaded the rest. Nothing was lost — scroll down and it is all there.

items.title: Folders to work inside
items.body: Pick a project from the switcher at the top left, or make one there. Everything you generate lands in it, and the gallery, Library and Prompts show only its things. Unsorted holds everything made outside a project.

items.title: Its own reference photos
items.body: Keep the photos a project reuses in the tray above the box. One click attaches one. Add from the + or from an attached photo's menu — Keep with this project.

items.title: Opens with the right settings
items.body: On the project card, Use current settings as its defaults. Opening the project, or arriving by its link, puts them on the pills.

items.title: Move pictures
items.body: Move to… in the viewer or the selection bar sends pictures to another project, to Unsorted, or to a new one. Deleting a project never deletes pictures — they go to Unsorted.

items.title: A link to the work
items.body: The address carries the project — /p/summer-gens — so a link opens a teammate on the same pictures, with the same settings.

items.title: One place to type and attach
items.body: The side panel is gone. Everything lives in the box at the bottom: your prompt, your photos as small chips, and the settings as pills with the price on every option.

items.title: Combine photos by number
items.body: Attach two or more photos and the first is the Base. Type @ to say which photo to take from — “the head from photo 2”. Drag the chips to change the order, click one to crop it.

items.title: A wall of pictures
items.body: The gallery is pictures only, packed together at their own shapes. Use the slider at the top to make them bigger or smaller. Older work loads as you scroll.

items.title: Click a picture for everything
items.body: The viewer shows the prompt, the photos it was made from, the cost, and every action. Scroll to zoom, drag to move, and press Before / after to compare an edit with the original.

items.title: Nothing needs attaching twice
items.body: The photos behind every edit are kept. Run again repeats it; Reuse photos and prompt puts it all back in the box to change.

items.title: Library and prompts
items.body: Star a picture to keep it in the Library for good. Every prompt you use is saved under Prompts, ready to copy or use again.

items.title: Delete has an undo
items.body: Deleting is instant, and for ten seconds you can take it back.

items.title: Make it yours
items.body: The round button at the top right holds your name, dark or light, an accent colour, and the keyboard shortcuts — or press ? any time.
